assumptions.challenge: Correlated batches, abandonment and matching bottlenecks violate the waiting model.
assumptions.text: Passenger parties follow a piecewise-constant NHPP induced by assumed flight-exit pulses; taxis ahead depart one per party in FCFS order.

assumptions.challenge: Congestion, shifts and risk aversion can alter the decision.
assumptions.text: Taxi destination mix is independent of queue waiting; city net opportunity cost is constant, A/B compared relative to future city earning.

assumptions.challenge: These are assumed design conditions, not surveyed facts; real geometry or violations invalidate safety applicability.
assumptions.text: Q3 has two 35m lanes, 7m bay pitch, protected holding and fenced crossings; passenger access and all vehicle motion are mutually exclusive.

assumptions.challenge: Insufficient demand/supply or correlated boarding changes achieved throughput.
assumptions.text: Q3 saturated passenger and taxi queues give a capacity bound; batch boarding durations are independent lognormal variables.

assumptions.challenge: Outside drivers, fraud and refusal require operating controls outside this simulation.
assumptions.text: Q4 closed fleet returns empty, destinations exogenous, credits cannot be sold or split and expire after one return visit.

assumptions.challenge: Actual calibration and external validation cannot be replaced by simulation.
assumptions.text: Every numeric scenario value is an explicit modeling assumption; no real airport/urban taxi observations are supplied.

formula_explanations.F1: Assumed party arrivals; G groups, t,c,w minutes, lambda groups/minute.
formula_explanations.F2: NHPP time-change order statistic, Δ CNY, r_city CNY/min; choose A if E[Delta]>=0.
formula_explanations.F3: A iff estimated E[W]<=W_star; ties choose A. Baseline static intensity, main MC, control fluid inverse.
formula_explanations.F4: Required empirical validation target in min²; NOT COMPUTED because no observed values exist.
formula_explanations.F5: Groups/hour; empirical capacity maximized over frozen n=1..5, all movement phases exclude pedestrians.
formula_explanations.F6: Short-trip credit in minutes, one use, expiry; priority at most every third dispatch and suspended when oldest ordinary wait reaches aging trigger.
formula_explanations.F7: Full round-trip tail accounting; fairness, throughput and delays reported separately without adjustable weighting.

symbols.Delta: incremental net value A over B [CNY]

unit_checks: All Q1 opportunity costs multiply CNY/min by minutes
Q4 hourly income uses minute exposure times factor 60
